attributes.title: 41st Annual Great Lakes Pharmacy Resident Conference
attributes.summary:
Residents from seven Great Lakes states gather at Purdue University on April 28 to 30, 2027, and the organizers report more than 900 attendees, about 600 residents and 300 preceptors. For a preceptor, it is a chance to earn pharmacy CE while hearing what residents across the region are working on.

The point most likely to catch people out is the claim window. You have only 14 days to finish the program evaluation at CESally.com, and evaluations are due May 11, 2027. Miss that and the ACPE credit is gone.

Residents must submit an abstract and CV by February 1, and early registration ends March 31. Fee amounts and credit hours are not published yet, and the schedule is not final.
